name: Forbidden-Minor Square of Adjacent Clause Signs
definition: Glue each of the four 900-concept root-section pivots at zero to a fresh-coordinate copy of $B_0$. For the two-connected version, add the common square tip joining root directions $0$ and $15$, encoded by $32769$.
parameters: The cut-vertex stage has four 1188-concept classes in dimension twenty-six; the square-completed stage has four 1189-concept two-connected classes. All have VC dimension five.
properties: At each stage the four classes have one common shadow and signs forming a square at a single clause. Exactly one class is a pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness; the other three peel. Every proper pc-minor of all eight classes peels.
